Name: SqueakyDuckShoes
Author: YourPeachiness
Description:
[center][size=5][b]🦆 Squeaky Duck Shoes[/b][/size][/center]
[center][i]Every step goes squeak.[/i][/center]

[line]

You have walked across this farm thousands of times.
Nobody ever said anything about it. Now something does.

This mod replaces your footsteps with a soft rubber-duck squeak — two alternating squeaks with slight pitch variation, so it never sounds like a loop. Quiet, goofy, and weirdly comforting when you're doing the fourth watering run of the day.

The optional [b]Content Patcher[/b] add-on also adds [b]Rubber Ducky Shoes[/b] to Marnie's shop, so the sound has an owner.

[line]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Squeaky footsteps[/b] — your step sounds are replaced with rubber-duck squeaks (two variants, pitch-randomized).[/*]
[*][b]Wear-conditioned[/b] — by default the squeak only happens in one specific pair of boots, so your regular shoes stay quiet.[/*]
[*][b]Two-in-one[/b] — leave it on as a tiny bit of farm ambience, or turn it into a running gag. Up to you.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] — [b]only[/b] for the optional add-on file[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

There are two files. Put both folders into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.

[list]
[*][b]Main file[/b] (SqueakyDuckShoes) — required. This is the sound mod.[/*]
[*][b]Optional file[/b] (SqueakyDuckShoes-CP) — adds the boots you can buy. Skip it if you'd rather have every pair squeak.[/*]
[/list]The zip is packed correctly: open it and [b]manifest.json[/b] should be right at the top, not inside a second folder.

With the add-on installed, buy the [b]Rubber Ducky Shoes[/b] from Marnie (12,000g) and put them on. Marnie will send you a letter about them.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Edit [b]config.json[/b] (or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]-compatible setup) and restart the game.

[code]
Enabled          true / false  Master switch. Turn it off when you need silence.
RequireBootsId  boots ID      Only this pair squeaks. Default is the Rubber Ducky Shoes.
Volume          0.0 - 1.0      Default 0.1 — deliberately quiet. Raise it if you want the full joke.
SpeedBonus      0.0            Optional bonus movement speed while squeaking. Off by default.[/code]Type [b]duck_status[/b] into the SMAPI console to print the current values.

[size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]

English and Chinese, both included. The boots name, description and Marnie's letter follow your game language.

[size=4][b]Known notes[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]The squeak replaces footstep audio, so it only plays when you take a step that would make a sound — riding a horse or a minecart won't squeak.[/*]
[*][b]Do not delete config.json.[/b] If it regenerates from scratch, the boots filter falls back to a placeholder ID and nothing will sound. See the pinned comment if that happens.[/*]
[/list][line]

[center][size=4][b]🦆 中文说明[/b][/center]

每天的农场路你要走上千步，从来没人吭过一声。现在有了。

这个 mod 把你走路的脚步声换成小黄鸭的吱吱叫——两段音效交替，每次音高略有浮动，所以听上去不会像复读机。音量很轻，有点傻，但在你浇第四遍地的时候，会莫名其妙地让人觉得没那么孤单。

可选的 [b]Content Patcher[/b] 附加包会在玛妮的店里加一双 [b]小黄鸭鞋[/b]，让这声音有个主人。

[b]安装[/b]
两个文件解压后把文件夹放进 Mods 目录：
· 主文件（必须）—— 脚步声本体
· 附加文件（可选）—— 增加可以买到的鞋。不装的话也可以让它对所有鞋生效。

装了附加包的话，去玛妮那儿花 12000g 买下小黄鸭鞋穿上，她会给你寄一封信。

[b]配置[/b]（改 config.json 后重启游戏）
· Enabled —— 总开关
· RequireBootsId —— 限定某双鞋才响，默认是小黄鸭鞋
· Volume —— 音量，默认 0.1，故意调得很轻
· SpeedBonus —— 可选的额外移速，默认关闭

控制台输入 [b]duck_status[/b] 可以查看当前配置。

[b]已知说明[/b]
· 叫声音效替换的是脚步声，所以只在真正迈步出声时触发——骑马、坐矿车不会响。
· [b]不要删除 config.json。[/b]若被重新生成，鞋子限定会回退到一个占位 ID，导致完全不响。

[line]

[i]Made because it seemed like the kind of thing the farm was missing.[/i]
